name: Mark Düsener
headline: CTIO Swisscom | Driving Swisscom’s TelCo to TechCo Transformation | People | AI | Cloud | Network | Data | Software Engineering | Best Net | Shaping 5G and future Networks | 6G
summary:
I am passionate about leading my world-class teams to drive our industry in its revolutionary transformation from TelCo to TechCo. This is what #5G really is about!

This transformation encompasses mainly four dimensions:
- Everything will be Software and Data, everything will become code, which used to be boxes 
- Everything will run cloud native
- Everything will be be AI and ML supported
But most importantly it is about People, People, People in mindest, culture and skills!

Empowering and supporting the agile and autonomous teams on their journey to a continuous learning organisation is my key accountability and source of joy and fun. I do this by creating clarity and perspective, providing directive where necessary and boldly leading the way.

I am convinced by this we will remain the team building and operating the best fixed mobile network and services, leading edge cloud and infrastructure plus excellent Data and AI services for Switzerland.

If you are interested to join our Journey take a look at https://www.swisscom.ch/de/about/karriere.html#karrierewelt #JoinSwisscom

positions.title: CTO and CIO, Member of the Executive Board
positions.description:
As CTIO, I lead the technology division at Swisscom and am a member of the Executive Board.

As Switzerland’s leading ICT and telecommunications company, Swisscom provides the digital backbone of the entire country with its infrastructure and services.

Based on our vision “Innovators of Trust” me and my management team enable and support our more than 4000 people within tech to provide our customers with world class networks - fixed and mobile, leading edge cloud and IT infrastructure services or data and AI based services. We constantly strive to redefine what’s possible within our industry together with our industry partners driving the transformation from Telco to TechCo.

Basis for this are a clear vision and strategy, broken down into executable goals and a corporate culture at Swisscom, that fosters flat hierarchies, transparent communication and constant open feedback across all levels.

Are you interested in working at Swisscom with cutting-edge technology, in agile as well as flat structures? We are looking for DevOps engineers, product owners & managers, solution managers, release train engineers and other talented individuals. We offer an inspiring working environment at our sites in Switzerland (https://www.swisscom.ch/de/about/karriere.html#karrierewelt), the Netherlands (Rotterdam, https://sdcrotterdam.swisscom.ch/) and Latvia (Riga, https://sdcriga.swisscom.ch/).

positions.title: Executive Vice President Mobile Network and Services
positions.description:
Leading and being part of the world-class team, developing and operating one of the best mobile networks and one of the best communication services in the world

- Heading the team of ~700 FTE building and running the mobile network and services for Swisscom
- Empowering the team to stay at the highest performance level, while transforming it from a communications team to a more software and cloud centric team – from Telco to TechCo
- Managing age transformation, skill transformation, new ways of sourcing, preparing change by creating levers to be more flexible and adaptive plus especially via team empowerment.
